subject.title: Telegram: ForceReply prompt for the argument when an args-requiring command is tapped from the menu with no argument

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in missing-argument prompt contract for native commands, and should Telegram map that prompt to ForceReply for commands such as /btw and /steer?
rationale: The change would add command registry semantics and a Telegram-specific native UI mapping; automation should not choose whether that contract belongs on built-in command metadata, plugin command metadata, or a portable presentation action.

options.title: Add opt-in prompt metadata
options.body: Define a narrow command-level prompt descriptor for selected freeform-argument commands and let Telegram render it as ForceReply.

options.title: Keep usage-only behavior
options.body: Continue returning usage text for bare command-menu taps until a broader native-command prompt design is approved.

options.title: Prototype in Telegram only
options.body: Implement a short Telegram allowlist for this UX while accepting drift risk from core command metadata and sibling channels.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in prompt metadata
recommendation.body: Define a narrow command-level prompt descriptor for selected freeform-argument commands and let Telegram render it as ForceReply.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is product/API-shaped and this owner has adjacent command-surface history, including the `/steer` command path used as one concrete example.
